snippet.title: Hotel Mogul Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Free: http://www.gamefools.com/pc-games/hotel-mogul.html

Lynette's conniving husband has cheated her out of her family business.  Use your business savvy to help Lynette repurchase her company and send her husband to the slammer.  Buy, develop and sell commercial properties to make a profit; build attractions that increase your income; and keep your eye on the bottom line as you purchase materials and hire workers.  The point-and-click fun of Hotel Mogul will have you laughing all the way to the bank.
